+import os

+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def extract_key_values(document_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract key-value pairs from form-like documents and return only a JSON object mapping field names to values.",
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": document_text}
+                ],
+            },
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+

+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text += content.get("text", "")
+
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError("No extracted content returned by OpenAI API")
+
+    return json.loads(text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    document_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_key_values(document_text)

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Union
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def _load_document_bytes(source: Union[str, bytes, bytearray]) -> bytes:
+    if isinstance(source, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        return bytes(source)
+    if source.startswith("http://") or source.startswith("https://"):
+        response = requests.get(source, timeout=60)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.content
+    with open(source, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def extract_tables(document_source: Union[str, bytes, bytearray]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    document_bytes = _load_document_bytes(document_source)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract all tables from this document. Return JSON only with a top-level key 'tables'. Each table must include rows, and each row must include cells in reading order. Preserve row and cell structure as faithfully as possible.",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_file",
+                        "filename": "document",
+                        "file_data": base64.b64encode(document_bytes).decode("ascii"),
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    text = ""
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text += content.get("text", "")
+
+    if not text:
+        raise RuntimeError("No table extraction output returned")
+
+    parsed = json.loads(text)
+    tables = parsed.get("tables", [])
+    if not isinstance(tables, list):
+        raise RuntimeError("Invalid tables payload")
+    return tables
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract tables from a document")
+    parser.add_argument("document", help="Path or URL to the document")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps({"tables": extract_tables(args.document)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+from urllib import request, error
+
+
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT", "").rstrip("/")
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY", "")
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION", "2024-02-29-preview")
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL", "prebuilt-layout")
+
+
+def _read_input(source: str) -> bytes:
+    if source.startswith("http://") or source.startswith("https://"):
+        with request.urlopen(source) as resp:
+            return resp.read()
+    return Path(source).read_bytes()
+
+
+def extract_layout(source: str, output: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT or not AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY are required")
+
+    data = _read_input(source)
+    analyze_url = f"{AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT}/documentintelligence/documentModels/{AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL}:analyze?api-version={AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION}"
+    headers = {
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY,
+        "Content-Type": "application/pdf" if source.lower().endswith(".pdf") else "application/octet-stream",
+    }
+    req = request.Request(analyze_url, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST")
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req) as resp:
+            operation_location = resp.headers.get("Operation-Location")
+    except error.HTTPError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(exc.read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")) from exc
+
+    if not operation_location:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing Operation-Location header from Azure Document Intelligence")
+
+    poll_headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY}
+    result: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for _ in range(120):
+        poll_req = request.Request(operation_location, headers=poll_headers, method="GET")
+        with request.urlopen(poll_req) as resp:
+            result = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+        status = result.get("status")
+        if status in {"succeeded", "failed", "canceled"}:
+            break
+    if result.get("status") != "succeeded":
+        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+
+    if output:
+        Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract layout elements from a document using Azure Document Intelligence")
+    parser.add_argument("source")
+    parser.add_argument("--output")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    extract_layout(args.source, args.output)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
